name: jubarte-wasm
description: Word-mode DOCX redline engine (jubarte-redlines) compiled to WebAssembly: compare two DOCX files into a tracked-changes redline, accept/reject revisions, list revisions, render DOCX to PDF, inspect and edit DOCX by paragraph id with edit plans. Node and browser builds included, plus compare-only slim builds without the PDF engine.

releaseNotes.0.9.2: docxToPdf gains revisions and revisionPalette arguments; PDFs follow Word's layout more closely and are smaller. Redline output unchanged.
releaseNotes.0.9.3: Redlines Word refused to open now open. A field whose code changed is replaced whole, and a same-code field stays whole, as in Word's redline. Table, list and section markup follow Word, and the same input writes the same bytes.
releaseNotes.0.10.0: jubarte-wasm gains the agent surface: inspectDocument, documentMarkdown, sourceSha256, applyEditPlan, previewEditPlan, editReportJsonl and capabilities in the full and slim builds; relationship targets holding & are no longer escaped twice.
releaseNotes.0.10.1: List, accept or reject tracked changes one at a time (listChanges, acceptChanges, rejectChanges, and resolve_revisions in edit plans), Word-parity Reject All, and a docx-to-PDF converter that follows Word much more closely on pagination, tables, headers and footers.
releaseNotes.0.11.0: New auditDocument, auditTracked, validateDocument, repairDocument, scrubDocument, appendDocuments, listComments, diffDocuments, updateFields and markdownToDocx; edit plans gain rewrite, tables, lists, run formatting, footnotes, images, page setup, content controls, watermark, redact and settings; a legacy .doc or encrypted input throws LEGACY_DOC; conventional marks follow Litera Compare; npx jubarte-redlines runs the CLI.
releaseNotes.0.11.2: Redlines follow Word's own rule for marking a changed paragraph word by word or replacing it whole; docxToPdf paints comments as Word's balloons and follows Word's layout more closely. On two 600-item samples scored against Word's own output: redlines mean 76.71 (Docxodus 69.24), PDFs mean 78.77 (LibreOffice 54.06), no failed item.
releaseNotes.0.11.3: docxToPdf sets OMML math in Cambria Math as Word does; a package that repeats an identical relationship Id opens repaired. On two 600-item samples scored against Word's own output: redlines mean 72.06 (Docxodus 65.15), counting as 0 the 23 redlines Word 16.115 crashes opening (KNOWN_ISSUES #8); PDFs mean 79.14 (LibreOffice 54.61), no failed document.
releaseNotes.0.12.0: Agent view and text diff views in WASM (flagPlan, changedView), docxToPdf's moveComments and changedOnly arguments, npx jubarte-redlines read/edit/add/convert with the native CLI's flags, docxToPdf text the bundled fonts cannot paint (Japanese) kept searchable and copyable, and redline fixes for files Word 16.115 hung on. On two 600-item samples scored against Word's own output: redlines mean 71.89 (Docxodus 64.95), counting as 0 the 23 redlines Word 16.115 crashes opening (KNOWN_ISSUES #8); PDFs mean 79.19 (LibreOffice 54.61), no failed document.
releaseNotes.0.13.0: replace keeps the words it keeps; one logical change per edit (listChanges members, composite ids); capabilityQuery runtime discovery; visible rejects (strike, restore); Word math as LaTeX and Markdown round-trips for charts, fields and images; docxToPdf lays out math, columns and header PAGE fields; Strict OOXML read and compared as itself; malformed ZIP packages refused (GHSA-m665-v7pm-7grj); npx jubarte-redlines prints what the binary prints. On two 600-item samples scored against Word's own output: redlines mean 71.63 (Docxodus 64.92), counting as 0 the 23 redlines Word 16.115 crashes opening (KNOWN_ISSUES #8); PDFs mean 79.19 (LibreOffice 54.61), no failed document.
releaseNotes.0.14.0: `read -p` repeats, `read --tables -o FILE` writes the grids, `changes --author NAME` filters, and `edit --help` shows the whole plan. Tracked edits keep formatting history apart and refuse duplicate revision ids; table redlines avoid the final-mark revision that hangs Word. Known: 3 of 600 sample redlines crash Word 16.115 where Word's own does not (#1802). 0.13.0 never reached npm; this is the first npm release since 0.12.0.
releaseNotes.0.15.0: Word-mode tables now pair, split and mesh as Word Compare does; validate with an original checks comments (FOREIGN_COMMENT); comments and edits no longer restyle or renumber what they did not touch; redlines with deleted page-numbered footers open in Word.
releaseNotes.0.16.0: Breaking: changes/comments --json print records only on stdout, and input_validity goes to stderr. validate finds more broken relationships and nameless move ranges; PDF tables past their grid take Word's widths; rewrites under keep mark one change per phrase.
releaseNotes.0.17.0: Security hardening: element budget, DTDs refused, compare story-unit budget and UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT instead of panics, optional JUBARTE_TIMEOUT. Breaking: limits gain max_xml_elements and max_story_units; one-shot edit/add need an author; --in-place replaces -o INPUT; --keep-others guards other authors markup.
